# Copilot Instructions for Resonate Website

This guide helps Copilot work effectively on the Resonate Music Therapy Studio website.

## Quick Start

React + TypeScript + Vite SPA, routed with TanStack Router, package-managed with pnpm.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev            # http://localhost:5173
```

## Build/Test/Lint

```bash
pnpm typecheck      # tsc project references
pnpm lint           # ESLint (flat config, eslint.config.js — not oxlint)
pnpm test           # Vitest + React Testing Library
pnpm test:e2e       # Playwright — builds and serves the app itself, no dev server needed first
pnpm build          # production build to dist/, includes typecheck + 404.html SPA fallback copy
```

Playwright serves a production build on port 4173 and, outside CI, reuses whatever is already listening there — stop a leftover `pnpm preview` before trusting an e2e result.

A failing test blocks deploy in CI (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`).

## Architecture

- **`src/routes/`** — TanStack Router file-based routes; file path maps to URL path (`routes/services/individual-therapy.tsx` → `/services/individual-therapy`). `src/routes/__root.tsx` is the shared root layout and also holds the not-found page for unknown URLs. `src/routeTree.gen.ts` is auto-generated by `pnpm dev`/`pnpm build`, overwritten in place — committed (so a fresh checkout can typecheck before Vite has run once) but never hand-edited.
- **`src/components/`** — `Nav`/`Footer` (rendered once by `__root.tsx`), `AmtaDefinition`, `DraftNotice`, `ImagePlaceholder`, `ToConfirm` (marks in place a fact the owner has not supplied yet — never fill such a gap with a guess; `grep -r "<ToConfirm" src` lists what is outstanding), and the page skeleton blocks: `PageIntro` (`h1`, lead paragraph, draft notice via `draft` prop), `Section`, `Band`, `SectionHeading`, `PointList`, `CardGrid`/`Card`, `Split` (picture beside copy), `Comparison` (with `TherapyVsLessons` and `IndividualVsGroup`), `ButtonLink`/`ButtonRow` (the call-to-action button), `ClosingCta` (every page's last section, ending at "Get in touch"), `QuestionList`/`Question` (question-and-answer list), `Testimonials` (Home's quote cards), and `StudioVideo` (the studio's click-to-play film). Build pages from these rather than hand-writing section/heading class strings; `Section` and `Band` style direct `<p>` children as body copy. Signing off a draft page means dropping `draft` from its `PageIntro` and the matching line in its route test.
- **`src/site/`** — site data with no React or asset imports (Playwright imports it; relative imports there carry `.ts`). `tempo-tunes.ts` holds Tempo Tunes' name, path, one-line summary, and class points (the registry takes its label and heading from it, so a rename starts there). `testimonials.ts` holds the family quotes shown on Home; a slot with `quote: null` renders as a `ToConfirm` placeholder, and a quote goes in only with the family's consent for the website. `contact.ts` holds the studio's phone, email, address, social links and tagline, rendered by `Footer` and the Contact page. `services.ts` is the Services catalogue (each Service's name, one-line description, and page or none), rendered by `ServiceCards` on Home and `/services`. `routes.ts` is the route registry: each page's path, nav label, heading and nav group. `Nav`, every route's `h1`, the tab title, and the Playwright specs all read it, so adding a page means a `src/routes/` file plus a registry entry.
- **`src/assets/`** — the logo, social SVGs, the photos the pages use and the studio film (`resonate-video-ad.mp4`, a 720p encode; its full-size source stays in the git-ignored `media-source/` because GitHub rejects files over 100 MB), imported as ES modules (build-time errors on typos, not runtime 404s). Only imported files belong here.
- **`public/`** — served verbatim: `favicon.ico`, `CNAME` (custom domain — do not delete/rename), `tempokids.jpg` (Open Graph image; `<meta>` tags aren't asset-processed by Vite, so it is a real static file referenced by absolute URL).
- **`src/test/`** — Vitest/RTL setup + tests, kept outside `src/routes/` so the router's file-based generator doesn't trip over non-route files. Route tests call `renderRoute('/path')` (`render-route.tsx`): real route tree on a memory router, queries scoped to `<main>`. They are the only place per-page content is asserted; draft pages are asserted with `getByRole('note')`, and only `draft-notice.test.tsx` pins the notice's wording.
- **`.design-sync/`** — inputs for importing the shared components into claude.ai/design; not part of the site build. Read `.design-sync/NOTES.md` before touching it.
- **`e2e/`** — Playwright specs for cross-site behaviour that needs a real browser (`nav`, `deep-links`, `link-hygiene`, `accessibility`), iterating the route registry in `src/site/routes.ts`. No per-page content specs — that belongs to the Vitest route tests.

The migration is complete (see `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/adr/`): every route carries real content and the Tailwind design system.

## Key Conventions

- TypeScript strict mode is on.
- Route files export only `export const Route = createFileRoute(...)`; the component itself is defined but not exported, and `react-refresh/only-export-components` is disabled for `src/routes/**` accordingly.
- Style with the brand tokens in `src/index.css` (`primary`/`secondary`/`accent`/`neutral`, `font-heading`/`font-body`), not stock Tailwind palettes or ad hoc CSS — the contrast audit in `e2e/accessibility.spec.ts` fails on off-palette colours. The page ground is warm `neutral-50`, not `bg-white`.

## Deployment

- **Platform:** GitHub Pages, deployed via `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` (GitHub Actions native Pages deployment, not "deploy from branch")
- **Domain:** Pinned via `public/CNAME`
- **Manual prerequisite:** repo Settings → Pages → Source must be set to "GitHub Actions" (admin-only, one-time) before this workflow can actually publish
